items.summary: Recommendation: approve containment-only execution and reject new spend, monetization expansion, forecasts, and unsupported revenue claims. Available revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; $0 is site-attributed, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable. The minimum measurement is one identical reporting window reconciling attributable revenue, AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and approved-budget costs, plus a defined learning outcome and incremental cost for each experiment. AI-cost records conflict: the current snapshot reports $881.36 across 4,832 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, while retained records report $973.35 across 5,439 calls; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and monthly budget limits are absent or incomplete. Treat impressions, clicks, rankings, sessions, conversions, ordered items without attributable commission, technical scores, and AI call counts as operating metrics, not financial returns. Retain the three CRO opportunities as deferred backlog only; continue existing repair-or-close, attribution reconciliation, and read-only legal/security evidence. Keep the gated product private and outreach unsent pending counsel and owner authorization.

CFO disposition: the candidate plan is financially acceptable only as containment. The three SEO/performance opportunities support prioritization, not revenue upside, contribution margin, cost-to-learn, or causal lift. Do not create proposals, experiments, telemetry requests, change requests, dependencies, deployments, or spending until the existing 47 failure follow-ups, 28 deployed improvements awaiting measurement, and attribution/cost reconciliation are resolved or explicitly dispositioned.
